{{Navbar-GOGPT-tracker}}
'''South Jamaica Power Centre''' is an operating power station of at least 194-megawatts (MW) in Old Harbour Bay, Saint Catherine, Jamaica.
It is also known as Old Harbour power plant.

==Background==

Fossil gas for the power plant is supplied by pipeline from New Fortress Energy's [[Old Harbour FSRU]].<ref name=":8">{{Cite web|url=https://ir.newfortressenergy.com/static-files/677b0744-1635-4e8b-8d01-33c51d178f75|title=Q3 2024 Investor Presentation|date=November 7, 2024|website=New Fortress Energy|url-status=live}}</ref>
